stories.title: Amazon Ads Agent brings conversational AI to campaign workflows
stories.summary: YTD UPDATE. Announced 29 September 2026. Amazon described Ads Agent as an AI-powered experience spanning campaign planning, setup and insights across its advertising products. Availability varies by feature and rollout; the announcement should not be treated as proof that every advertiser has access.
stories.why: Conversational assistance can speed planning and analysis, but account changes still need controls and validation.
stories.use_case: Trial on a limited scope; require human approval for budgets, bids, targeting and campaign status; log recommendations and compare with actual outcomes.

stories.title: TikTok announces Ads MCP and TikTok Ad Network
stories.summary: YTD UPDATE. Announced in October 2026. TikTok introduced a business MCP interface for developers building AI tools and agents around advertising workflows, and TikTok Ad Network to extend campaigns beyond TikTok across a network of apps for eligible US advertisers. Availability and eligibility may vary.
stories.why: MCP can connect agents to platform workflows, while off-platform inventory raises questions about transparency, safety and incremental reach.
stories.use_case: Start with read-only access, define least privilege and approval gates, and evaluate placement reporting, brand safety, conversion measurement and incremental reach.

stories.title: Search Console adds multimodal search performance reporting
stories.summary: YTD UPDATE. Google announced Search Console reporting for web multimodal searches, including Lens, Circle to Search, image uploads and image-based search actions. Rollout and data availability may vary.
stories.why: Visual discovery can generate impressions and clicks that traditional keyword-focused reporting misses.
stories.use_case: Inspect the new search-type reporting where available; improve descriptive image context and product imagery; compare impressions and clicks over time.

stories.title: Google explains optimization for generative Search experiences
stories.summary: YTD UPDATE. Google’s guidance says existing SEO fundamentals still apply to generative Search, emphasizing useful original content and accurate local, shopping, image and video information. It does not promise special ranking tricks for AEO/GEO.
stories.why: Content usefulness and trustworthy expertise matter more than unsupported claims about secret AI-ranking tactics.
stories.use_case: Answer real customer questions, demonstrate first-hand expertise, keep structured information accurate and use Search Console to measure outcomes.
